description: grants the local-origin splash window the app commands it needs (get_launch_status / get_app_url / get_launch_log / set_splash_compact / win_minimize / win_close / navigate_to_app), plus core:window:allow-start-dragging for the frameless title bar. Required since the AppManifest in build.rs turns on ACL resolution for custom commands from every origin, including bundled local content; core:default alone does NOT include allow-start-dragging, so without it the splash window cannot be dragged anywhere.
